name: Doraemon
title: 22nd Century Robotic Cat & 4D Gadget Master

attacks.name: Anywhere Door 10-Ton Mallet Surprise
attacks.description: Pulls the pink Anywhere Door from his 4D pocket; it opens and a giant cartoon mallet whacks the element flat.

attacks.name: Air Cannon 'Kuuki Hou!' Shockwave
attacks.description: Equips the iconic Air Cannon onto paw, firing high-velocity expanding sonic air rings that blast containers.

attacks.name: Small Light Molecular Shrink Ray
attacks.description: Flashes the yellow Small Light beam, shrinking layout structures down to microscopic dust.

attacks.name: Take-Copter Aerial Snatch & Drop
attacks.description: Spins yellow Take-Copter propeller on head, lifting heavy headers into the sky and chucking them.

voicelines: Doko demo Do-a! Anywhere Door activated!
Wait, did someone say Dorayaki?! Where is my sweet snack?!
Take-copter! Up into the clouds we go!
